words.desc: A large reptile with a broad rounded snout that lives in swamps of the southern United States.
A tiny insect that lives in large organised colonies and can carry heavy loads.
A small winged mammal that hunts at night by listening for echoes to find prey.
A large heavy mammal with thick fur and strong claws that may sleep through winter.
A large rodent with big front teeth and a flat paddle-shaped tail that builds dams.
A small flying insect that gathers pollen and nectar to feed its colony.
A flying insect with large colourful wings that develops from a caterpillar.
A desert animal with one or two humps that can go a long time without water.
A slow-moving lizard that can change the colour of its skin.
The fastest land animal, a slender spotted cat built for sprinting.
A common farm bird kept for its eggs and meat that cannot fly far.
A large domestic grazing animal kept on farms for its milk and beef.
A shelled creature with ten legs and two big claws that walks sideways.
A large reptile with a long snout and powerful jaws that lurks in rivers.
A large intelligent black bird with a harsh cawing call.
A graceful hoofed animal of woods and fields whose males grow antlers.
A highly intelligent sea mammal famous for its playful leaps and clicking calls.
A water bird with a broad flat bill and webbed feet that quacks.
A large powerful bird of prey with a hooked beak and keen eyesight.
A huge grey mammal with a long flexible nose and large tusks.
A tall pink bird with long thin legs that feeds in shallow salty lakes.
A small wild member of the dog family with a bushy tail and pointed ears.
A small tailless amphibian with long back legs that leaps and croaks near water.
A small lizard with sticky toe pads that lets it climb walls and ceilings.
The tallest animal, with an extremely long neck and a patterned coat.
A sure-footed horned farm animal with a short beard that will eat almost anything.
The largest ape, a powerful forest dweller that lives in family groups.
A small chubby rodent with stretchy cheek pouches, popular as a pet.
A small nocturnal mammal covered in sharp spines that rolls into a ball when scared.
A huge round African mammal that spends its days wallowing in rivers.
A large hoofed animal with a flowing mane that people have ridden for centuries.
A tiny brightly coloured bird that hovers in mid-air by beating its wings very fast.
A large plant-eating lizard with a spiny crest along its back.
A soft see-through ocean animal with a bell-shaped body and stinging tentacles.
A large Australian marsupial that hops on powerful back legs and carries young in a pouch.
A tree-dwelling Australian marsupial with grey fur that feeds on eucalyptus leaves.
A small round insect with a shiny red shell dotted with black spots.
A powerful spotted wild cat that often drags its prey up into trees.
A large wild cat of Africa whose males have a thick shaggy mane.
A long-necked South American pack animal with thick woolly fleece.
A large shelled sea creature with a long tail and big front claws, often eaten as a delicacy.
A playful tree-dwelling primate with nimble hands and usually a long tail.
The largest member of the deer family, with broad flat antlers and a long face.
A small flying insect whose bite leaves an itchy bump on the skin.
A tiny rodent with a pointed nose, round ears and a long thin tail.
A soft-bodied sea creature with eight long limbs and a rounded head.
The largest living bird, which cannot fly but runs extremely fast on two long legs.
A playful furry mammal that swims in rivers and seas and eats fish.
A nocturnal bird of prey with large forward-facing eyes and silent flight.
A rare two-toned mammal from the mountain forests of central China.
A brightly coloured tropical bird with a curved beak that can mimic speech.
A large male bird famous for fanning out a shimmering tail of eye-patterned feathers.
A large water bird with a huge throat pouch on its long bill for scooping fish.
A flightless black and white seabird that swims expertly in cold southern seas.
A stout farm animal with a flat snout, often kept for its meat.
A plump grey bird common in city squares that coos and bobs its head.
A huge white predator that roams the frozen far north hunting on sea ice.
A large rodent covered in long sharp quills that it raises when threatened.
A small furry burrowing animal with long ears and a short fluffy tail.
A clever nocturnal mammal with a black mask-like face and a ringed tail.
A massive thick-skinned grazing animal with one or two horns on its snout.
An eight-legged desert creature with pincers and a curved venomous tail.
A noisy white and grey bird of the coast known for stealing food from people.
A sleek marine mammal with flippers that rests on shores and swims in cold waters.
A large predatory fish with rows of sharp teeth and a skeleton made of cartilage.
A woolly farm animal raised in flocks for its fleece and meat.
A black and white mammal that sprays a foul-smelling liquid when threatened.
A slow-moving tree-dwelling mammal that hangs upside down from branches.
A slow soft-bodied creature that carries a spiral shell on its back.
A long legless reptile that slithers along the ground and flicks its tongue.
A small eight-legged creature that spins silk webs to trap insects.
A small tree-climbing rodent with a big bushy tail that stores nuts.
A large graceful water bird with a long curved neck, usually pure white.
The largest wild cat, with an orange coat marked by black stripes.
A reptile with a hard shell that lives mainly in water and swims with flippers.
A large Arctic marine mammal with long tusks and a bristly moustache.
An enormous ocean mammal that breathes air through a blowhole and sings underwater.
A wild canine that lives and hunts in packs and howls at night.
A long thin soft-bodied creature without legs that burrows through soil.
A wild African grazing animal whose coat is covered in bold dark bands.
